intro:
  full: >-
    I am an engineer who also spent the better part of a decade running enterprise IT and security,
    which means I build software and I have also been the person on the wrong end of the pager at
    2am. Twelve-plus years across full-stack development, DevOps, and regulated-industry IT —
    casinos, healthcare, manufacturing, government. I codify, version, review, and secure the things
    most shops do by hand.
  dev: >-
    Full-stack engineer and architect. I built BetterLife's entire platform from zero (frontend,
    backend, ML, databases, CI/CD) and led the team that ran it, and I ship production-grade SaaS
    solo today on a current edge stack. I write the kind of code I would want to inherit.
  it: >-
    Seven-plus years of enterprise IT with a security-first, automate-everything bias. Led the
    PrintNightmare response across a regulated MSP client base, spent two years as a PCI-DSS SME,
    and built an mTLS RMM platform in Go. Audit-experienced, not yet audit-certified — and I will
    tell you exactly which.
  leader: >-
    I have managed 75+ direct reports on a casino floor (real HR-side ownership, discipline
    included) and hired and led a team of 6 engineers at a startup that turned profitable in year
    one. I co-own two businesses and a real-estate partnership, so P&L is not an abstraction to me.

I keep the canonical version of all of this in a [resume repo](https://github.com/sethbrasile)

CVs go stale. Use the lens toggle above to reweight the page toward **development**,
**IT / security**, or **leadership** — or leave it on **Full** for everything.
